title: Rezoning text change for 63-02 Fresh Pond Road, Queens
summary: This application would amend the city's zoning map rules to require affordable housing at 63-02 Fresh Pond Road in Ridgewood, Queens by establishing a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area. It pairs with a related zoning map change that would allow a new seven-story mixed-use building with 54 apartments, including 13 income-restricted units. The Council's Land Use Committee recommended approval on July 14, 2026.
